name: salvage-rights
description: Salvage Rights — an AI-assisted Collect-or-Steal game for 2–6 players on Next.js + Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.test:unit: npm run test -w @salvage-rights/engine && npm run test -w @salvage-rights/protocol && npm run test -w @salvage-rights/worker
scripts.dev: npm run build:web && npm run dev:worker
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run build:web && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
scripts.deploy: npm run build:web && npm run deploy -w @salvage-rights/worker
